summary: New York City, software engineer, strong interest in programming languages (especially Clojure and Python), advocates for open-source software, critical of Google and its practices, has experience with Linux and command-line interfaces, has a personal website (lee-phillips.org), has dealt with Lyme disease, has a family, expresses strong opinions on social and political issues, particularly regarding privacy and technology, engages in self-experimentation, has a background in physics, and has a critical view of mainstream media and its influence.
